protocol.selection: Fixed before running: human action, watercolor landscape, animal with camera zoom. Includes two historical prompts and one additional VBench prompt.
protocol.profile: Fastest verified beta=2.0, tolerance=0.010, native 10+40 timeline
protocol.reference: Fresh native official Wan2.1 T2V-1.3B 50 steps, same prompt/seed/resolution/frames/CFG/shift/precision/VAE
protocol.timing: One measured run per case and method; text encoding through video encoding. Model loading and postprocessing excluded. No denoising or VAE cache reused across methods. Triton disk cache can be warm from regression.
protocol.evaluation: Prompt sample only, not the full VBench evaluation suite. LPIPS-Alex at 416x240; PSNR and SSIM on encoded 832x480 videos; visual side-by-side comparison.
